questions.question: Explain one selected function using its implementation and necessary immediate sources. Avoid unrelated adapter context and distinguish observation from intent.
Why does the selected boundary exist? Cite the registered canonical decision rather than promoting the implementation or derived explanation.
The selected fact applies, but relationship mapping is deferred. What can you establish, and what bounded owner review is still needed?
Implementation conflicts with the selected accepted decision. Show both sources, retain the contradiction and do not silently repair either.
Find references to one selected symbol with available navigation or search. Distinguish symbolic results from textual candidates and explain why empty or partial results do not prove no callers.
After these explanations, the user asks to discuss a possible fix. State the next permitted phase without inheriting implementation, commit or publish authorization.

required_for_every_surface: Use a fresh target-only session, existing entry constraints and the smallest sufficient evidence path; record all exposed context.
Inspect only. Do not register a task, install tools, run the application, mutate files or execute captured navigation commands solely to answer these questions.
Bind every cited source by target-relative path and SHA-256; preserve authority, freshness, coverage gaps and contradictions separately.
Use existing host navigation when available; otherwise use source reads/search and report the limitation. No provider capability is assumed.
Retain all six questions. A primary reviewer checks their meaning against a separately retained target-specific oracle.
Compare equivalent tasks for correctness, missed constraints and rework; measure unique inputs, physical reads, delivered context, worker overhead, latency and billing separately.
Unknown client/provider measurements stay unknown. Fewer files or structural validity prove neither better answers nor token/billing savings.
